title: TRI-X: A Framework for Triage, TiTrATE Reasoning, Safety Governance, and Transparent Decision Support
description: A framework-level package for clinical decision support that estimates triage risk, applies TiTrATE dizziness reasoning, enforces safety-governance and audit logic, and produces transparent, explainable decisions. All reported metrics are computed on a synthetic cohort by a deterministic seed-42 driver (scripts/run_all.py) and reproduce byte-for-byte, with figures rendered from the computed results.
